mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[User] WHERE Username = #{username}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[User] WHERE Email = #{email}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.[User] (Username, Email, PasswordHash, DisplayName, LastLoginAt) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, SYSUTCDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.[User] SET LastLoginAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE UserId = #{userId}
